title: Functional Still — Rams Catalog Portrait
description: A single-product introduction slide channeling Braun's 1970s industrial catalog: one silhouette, one sentence, one typeface, nothing else. Unlike other minimalist templates, negative space is load-bearing structure here, not cosmetic padding.
philosophy: This template holds that restraint is a form of respect — for the product, the viewer, and their time. It takes Dieter Rams's maxim 'less, but better' as a hard constraint, refusing gradients, icons, and decoration entirely. A ruling line may appear; nothing else competes with the object. It is built for speakers who trust the product to carry the room, not the slide.
goodFor: Industrial or product design portfolio reviews
3-line product name, function, and spec reveals
Premium electronics press and investor first-looks
avoidFor: Brand decks that rely on color narrative or gradient storytelling
Content requiring more than four text elements per slide
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide evokes a 1970s Braun product catalog page — stark, purposeful, and utterly self-assured, as though the object needs no introduction but receives exactly one. A single product silhouette floats in the upper field while negative space operates as load-bearing structure, not emptiness. The mood is cold-precision restraint cut with quiet warmth: the object is the entire argument, and everything else defers. Avoid any shadow, texture, gradient, decorative mark, or secondary visual that might fracture the silhouette's silence.

examples.layoutNotes: Portrait editorial grid, twelve columns with breathing outer margins on all sides — catalog-style containment, not cosmetic padding. The product silhouette zone claims the upper two-thirds of the canvas, centered within columns two through eleven, with no bleed. A single hairline ruling line bisects the composition, acting as the hard boundary between the silhouette register above and the text register below. Title and one-line function descriptor sit left-aligned in the lower third; a page folio appears at the far-right baseline if present at all — no header band, no footer bar.

examples.promptCore: The slide feels like a page extracted from a Braun product catalog circa 1972 — clinical, unhurried, and quietly authoritative. One horizontal rule is the only permitted mark; everything else is text and void locked in asymmetric tension, content massing left-of-center while the right half holds open as a load-bearing counter-weight. The mood is printed object, not digital presentation — avoid any softness, rounding, decorative flourish, or compositional gesture that would break the sense of cold industrial precision.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
  <rect width="1920" height="1080" fill="#f5f0e6"/>

  <!-- Top metadata row: label zone above the rule -->
  <g font-family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif" fill="#1e1c1a">
    <text x="227" y="170" font-size="15" font-weight="500" letter-spacing="3.2">SECTION 04 · FORM & FUNCTION</text>
  </g>
  <g font-family="ui-monospace, monospace" fill="#7a7468">
    <text x="813" y="170" font-size="15" letter-spacing="2.4">REF. T 1000 / WELTEMPFÄNGER</text>
    <text x="1253" y="170" font-size="15" letter-spacing="2.4">CAT. 1972 — PLATE 07</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Dominant upper-third ruling line (full width, hairline) -->
  <line x1="80" y1="360" x2="1840" y2="360" stroke="#1e1c1a" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Kicker immediately under rule -->
  <text x="227" y="418" font-family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" letter-spacing="4.6" fill="#7a7468">SPECIFICATION — PRINCIPLE NO. 06</text>

  <!-- Dominant callout: the spec line -->
  <g font-family="Georgia, ui-serif, serif" fill="#1e1c1a">
    <text x="227" y="560" font-size="108" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="-3.5">Good design</text>
    <text x="227" y="680" font-size="108" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="-3.5" font-style="italic">is as little design</text>
    <text x="227" y="800" font-size="108" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="-3.5">as possible.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Secondary line at reduced weight, below dominant -->
  <g font-family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif" fill="#7a7468">
    <text x="227" y="878" font-size="22" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.4">Less, but better — because it concentrates on the essential aspects,</text>
    <text x="227" y="910" font-size="22" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.4">and the products are not burdened with non-essentials.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Accent micro-mark: single red register (the one permitted color signal) -->
  <text x="920" y="418" font-family="ui-monospace, monospace" font-size="16" letter-spacing="2.4" fill="#7d2a2a">— 06 / 10</text>

  <!-- Footer / page indicator flush bottom-right -->
  <g font-family="ui-monospace, monospace" fill="#1e1c1a">
    <text x="1840" y="1010" font-size="15" letter-spacing="2" text-anchor="end">RAMS · BRAUN AG · KRONBERG</text>
    <text x="1840" y="1036" font-size="15" letter-spacing="2" text-anchor="end">PAGE 07 / 24</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Left-margin vertical metadata (cold, catalog feel) -->
  <g font-family="ui-monospace, monospace" fill="#7a7468" font-size="13" letter-spacing="2">
    <text x="80" y="1036">FUNCTIONAL STILL</text>
  </g>
</svg>
examples.layoutNotes: Portrait editorial grid, 12 columns; content anchors to cols 2–7 with cols 8–12 held as intentional structural void — not overflow space. A single full-width ruling line falls at roughly the upper third, separating a terse label zone above from a dominant spec line or callout below, with no other graphic elements present. Hierarchy is expressed through weight contrast alone; a secondary line may sit below the dominant line at reduced weight. Page number is placed flush bottom-right at the outer margin.
